verses: Jin logon ney kufur kiya aur Allah ki raah say roka Allah ney unn kay aemaal barbaad ker diye

Aur jo log eman laye aur achay kaam kiye aur uss per bhi eman laye jo Muhammad) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (per utari gaee hai aur dar-asal unn kay rab ki taraf say sacha (deen) bhi o hi hai, Allah ney unn kay gunah door ker diye aur unn kay haal ki islaah ker di
Yeh uss liye kay kafiron ney baatil ki pairwee ki aur mominon ney uss deen haq ki ittabaa ki jo unn kay Allah ki taraf say hai, Allah Taalaa logon ko unn kay ehwaal ussi tarah batata hai

To jab kafiron say tumhari mud-bher ho to gardano per waar maaro. Jab unn ko achi tarah kuchal dalo to abb khoob mazboot qaid o band say giriftar kero, (phir ikhtiyar hai) kay khuwah ehsan rakh ker chor do ya fidya ley ker ta-waqt-e-kay laraee apney hathyaar rakh dey. Yehi hukum hai aur Allah agar chahata to (khud) hi unn say badla ley leta, lekin (uss ka mansha yeh hai) kay tum mein say aik ka imtehan doosray kay zariye say ley ley, jo log Allah ki raah mein shaheed ker diye jatay hain Allah unn kay aemaal hergiz zaya na keray ga
Unhen raah dikhaye ga aur unn kay halaat ki islaah ker dey ga
Aur unhen uss jannat mein ley jaye ga jiss say unhen shanasa ker diya hai
Aey eman walo! agar tum Allah (kay deen) ki madad kero gay to woh tumhari madad keray ga aur tumhen sabit qadam rakhay ga
Aur jo log kafir huye unhen halaki ho Allah unn kay aemaal ghaarat kerdey ga
Yeh uss liye kay woh Allah ki nazil kerdah cheez say khush huye, pus Allah Taalaa ney (bhi) unn kay aemaal zaya ker diye
Kiya unn logon ney zamin mein chal phir ker uss ka moaeena nahi kiya kay unn say pehlay kay logon ka nateeja kiya hua? Allah ney unhen halak ker diya aur kafiron kay liye ussi tarah ki sazayen hain
Woh uss liye kay eman walon ka kaarsaaz khud Allah Taalaa hai aur uss liye kay kafiron ka koi kaarsaaz nahi

Jo log eman laye aur unhon ney nek aemaal kiye unhen Allah Taalaa aisay baghon mein dakhil keray ga jin kay neechay nehren jari hain aur jo log kafir huye woh (duniya hi ka) faeedah utha rahey hain aur misil chopayon kay kha rahey hain, unn ka (asal) thikana jahannum hai
Hum ney kitni bastiyon ko jo taqat mein teri uss basti say ziyadah thin jiss say tujhay nikala hum ney unhen halak ker diya hai, jin ka madadgar koi na utha

Kiya pus woh shakhs jo apney perwerdigar ki taraf say daleel per ho uss shakhs jaisa ho sakta hai? Jiss kay liye uss ka bura kaam muzayyan ker diya gaya ho aur woh apni nafsani khuwaishon ka pairo ho?

Uss jannat ki sift jiss ka perhezgaron say wada kiya gaya hai, yeh hai kay uss mein pani ki nehren hain jo badboo kerney wala nahi, aur doodh ki nehren hain jin ka maza nahi badla aur sharab ki nehren hain jin mein peenay walon kay liye bari lazzat hai aur nehren hain shehad ki jo boht saaf hain aur unn kay liye o haan her qasam kay meway hain aur unn kay rab ki taraf say maghfirat hai, kiya yeh misil uss kay hain jo hamesha aag mein rehney wala hai? Aur jinhen garum kholta hua pani pilaya jaye ga jo unn ki aanton ko tukray tukray ker dey ga

Aur unn mein baaz (aisay bhi hain kay) teri taraf kaan lagatay hain. Yahan tak kay jab teray pass say jatay hain to ahl ilm say (ba-waja kund zehni zehni-o-laperwahee kay) poochtay hain kay uss ney abhi kiya kaha tha? Yehi log hain jin kay dilon per Allah ney mehar ker di hai aur woh apni khuwaishon ki pairwee kertay hain
Aur jo log hidayat yafta hain Allah ney unhen hidayat mein aur barha diya hai aur unhen unn ki perhezgari ata farmaee hai
To kiya yeh qayamat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay woh unn kay pass achanak aajaye yaqeenan uss ki alamaten to chuki hain, phir jabkay unn kay pass qayamat aajaye unhen naseehat kerna kahan hoga?

So (aey nabi!) aap yaqeen ker len kay Allah kay siwa koi mabood nahi aur apney gunahon ki bakhsish maanga keren aur momin mardon aur momin aurton kay haq mein bhi, Allah tum logon ki aamad amdoraft ki aur rehney sehney ki jagah ko khoob janta hai

Aur jo log eman laye woh kehtay hain koi surat kiyon nazil nahi ki gaee? Phir jab koi saaf matlab wali surat nazil ki jati hai aur uss mein qitaal ka zikar kiya jata hai to aap dekhtay hain kay jin logon kay dilon mein beemari hai woh aap ki taraf uss tarah dekhtay hain jaisay uss shakhs ki nazar hoti hai jiss per maut ki beyhoshi taari ho, pus boht behtar tha unn kay liye
Farman ka baja lana aur achi baat ka kehna. Phir jab kaam muqarrar ho jaye, to Allah kay sath sachay rahen to unn kay liye behtri hai
Aur tum say yeh bhi baeed nahi kay agar tum ko hukoomat mill jaye to tum zamin mein fasad barpa ker do aur rishtay naatay tor dalo
Yeh o hi log hain jin per Allah ki phitkaar hai aur jin ki sama’at aur aankhon ki roshni cheen li hai
Kiya yeh quran mein ghor ghor-o-fiker nahi kertay? Ya unn kay dilon per talay lag gaye hain
Jo log apni peeth kay bal ultay phir gaye uss kay baad unn kay liye hidayat wazeh ho chuki yaqeenan shetan ney unn kay liye (unn kay fail ko) muzayyan ker diya hai aur unhen dheel dey rakhi hai

Yeh uss liye kay unhon ney unn logon say jinhon ney Allah ki nazil kerdah wahee ko bura samjha yeh kaha kay hum bhi unqareeb baaz kaamon mein tumhara kaha manen gay, aur Allah unn ki posheedah baaten khoob janta hai
Pus unn ki kaisi (durgat) hogi jabkay farishtay unn ki rooh qabz kertay huye unn kay chehron aur unn ki sareenon per maaren gay
Yeh uss bana per kay yeh woh raah chalay jiss say unhon ney Allah ko naraz ker diya aur unhon ney uss ki raza mandi ko bura jana, to Allah ney unn kay aemaal ikaarat ker diye
Kiya unn logon ney jin kay dilon mein beemari hai yeh samajh rakha hai kay Allah unn kay keeno ko zahir na keray ga

Aur agar hum chahatay to unn sab ko tujhay dikha detay pus to unhen unn kay chehray say hi pehchan leta, aur yaqeenan to unhen unn ki baat kay dhab say pehchan ley ga, tumharay sab kaam Allah ko maloom hain
Yaqeenan hum tumhara imtehan keren gay takay tum mein say jihad kerney walon aur sabar kerney walon ko zahir ker den aur hum tumhari halaton ki bhi jaanch ker len

Yaqeenan jin logon ney kufur kiya aur Allah ki raah say logon ko roka aur rasool ki mukhalifat ki uss kay baad kay unn kay liye hidayat zahir ho chuki yeh hergiz hergiz Allah ka kuch nuksan na ker saken gay. Unqareeb unn kay aemaal woh ghaarat kerdey ga
Aey eman walo! Allah ki ita’at kero aur rasool ka kaha mano aur apney aemaal ko ghaarat na kero
Jin logon ney kufur kiya aur Allah ki raah say auron ko roka phir kufur ki halat mein hi marr (yaqeen ker lo) kay Allah unhen hergiz na bakhshay ga
Pus tum bodhay bann ker sulah ki darkhuast per na utar aao jabkay tum hi buland o ghalib raho gay aur Allah tumharay sath hai, na-mumkin hai kay woh tumharay aemaal zaya ker dey
Waqaee zindagani duniya to sirf khel kood hai aur agar tum eman ley aao gay aur taqwa ikhtiyar kero gay to Allah tumhen tumharay ajar dey ga aur woh tum say tumharay maal nahi mangta
Agar woh tum say tumhara maal mangay aur zor dey ker mangay to tum uss say bakheeli kerney lago gay aur woh tumharay keenay zahir ker dey ga

Khabardaar! tum woh log ho kay Allah ki raah mein kharach kerney kay liye bulaye jatay ho, to tum mein say baaz bakheeli kerney lagtay hain aur jo bukhul kerta hai woh to dar-asal apni jaan say bakheeli kerta hai. Allah Taalaa ghani hai aur tum faqir (aur mohtaj) ho aur agar tum roogardaan ho jao to woh tumharay badlay tumharay siwa aur logon ko laye ga jo phir tum jaisay na hun gay
